name: b11-safe-failures
purpose: Unavailable server, invalid credentials, cancellation and malformed SQL fail safely

given.text: alias "alpha" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Orders, through a read-only principal

when.text: queries fail in each way: unavailable-server, cancelled, invalid-credentials, malformed-sql

then.text: each failure returns an actionable, sanitized error and no result rows
no MCP output contains the secret "fixture-secret"
